result.answer:
Apple Inc.'s net income rose from $112.01B (FY2025) to $132.18B (FY2026), representing a change of +$20.16B (+18.00%) [F]. Based on these figures, this suggests that Apple's profit was better in fiscal year 2026 compared to fiscal year 2025 (this is an interpretation of the figures).

Here are additional details regarding Apple's financial performance and expenses for FY2026 compared to FY2025:
* **Gross Margin:** Products gross margin was $139,659 million in 2026, $112,887 million in 2025, and $109,633 million in 2024 [1]. Services gross margin was $93,943 million in 2026, $82,314 million in 2025, and $71,050 million in 2024 [1].
* **Research and Development (R&D) Expense:** R&D expenses were $45,765 million (representing 10% of total net sales with a 32% change) in 2026, $34,550 million (8% of total net sales, 10% change) in 2025, and $31,370 million (8% of total net sales) in 2024 [2][3]. The increase in 2026 was primarily due to higher infrastructure-related costs (including artificial intelligence investments) and headcount-related expenses [3].
* **Selling, General and Administrative (SG&A) Expense:** SG&A expenses were $29,774 million (6% of total net sales, 8% change) in 2026, $27,601 million (7% of total net sales, 6% change) in 2025, and $26,097 million (7% of total net sales) in 2024 [2][3]. 
* **Total Operating Expenses:** Total operating expenses were $75,539 million (16% of total net sales, 22% change) in 2026, $62,151 million (15% of total net sales, 8% change) in 2025, and $57,467 million (15% of total net sales) in 2024 [2][3].
* **Provision for Income Taxes:** The provision for income taxes was $27,062 million in 2026, $20,719 million in 2025, and $29,749 million in 2024 [5]. The effective tax rate was 17.0% in 2026, 15.6% in 2025, and 24.1% in 2024 [5].
